dict.string: JameClaw uses notifications to show alerts for agent actions, automation results, and gateway status changes.
JameClaw can capture the screen when you ask an agent to use screenshots as context.
JameClaw can access the camera when you ask an agent to capture photos or video context.
JameClaw uses the microphone for voice messages and voice-driven agent workflows.
JameClaw can use speech recognition when you enable voice-driven workflows.
JameClaw uses Automation permission when you ask an agent to control local apps or run macOS workflows.
JameClaw uses the local network to connect the Web Console, gateway, extensions, and local model services.
JameClaw can access Reminders when you ask an agent to work with reminders.
